text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Several political parties hold meetings to decide on participation in June 5 parliamentary elections or to unveil alliances with other groups to compete in poll.
- Security forces kill head of Algerian Jihad Islamic Front and two of his associates in Algiers.
- 14 "terrorists" shot dead in southern province of M'sila during operation by security forces in past few days.
- Abdallah Djaballah, leader of Nahda party, says he is not a candidate for legislative elections.
- World Bank lends Algeria $89 million to finance community projects.
